title.narrative: Output 4.3. Increased capacity of Member States to develop policies, legislation and other measures that are specifically aimed at facilitating the transition of enterprises to formality

description.narrative:
1. A National Advisory Taskforce on formalization, composed of different members from the national partners including governmental agencies, social partners, and academia was set up in 2022 to facilitate the policy dialogue on transition and formalization.
2. The finalized report on the Theory of Change of formalization from informal economy to formal economy was endorsed by all the members of the National Advisory Taskforce. 1. ILO is co-chairs the National Advisory Taskforce that gathers all the national partners to discuss and agree about the work on formalisation from different dimensions, and promoting the work on informality with both governmental agencies and social partners.
2. ILO has provided technical support for developing and publishing the Theory of Change for Formalisation in Viet Nam and some other technical reports to disseminate broadly to the national partners, for further policy advocacy.

description.narrative: On 2 June 2023 the National Assembly adopted Resolution 89/2023/QH15 which endorsed the Policy Orientation for revising the revised Employment Law No 38/2013/QH13. In February 2023, the Government completed the dossier to revise the Employment Law, including the Policy Orientation and submitted to the National Assembly. The Law proposes policy options to strengthen the legal, institutional and financial sustainability dimensions of the unemployment insurance system, including extension of UI coverage to workers with 1-month contracts and promotion and strengthening of the active component of unemployment scheme. ILO developed evidence supporting the strengthening of the coverage and levels of support provided by employment protection and unemployment insurance programmes through a "Stock-taking report on the implementation of Unemployment Insurance scheme and Policy recommendations for reforming the Unemployment policies in Viet Nam". The report was submitted to the Government and contributed to the revision of the Employment Law. ILO conducted the actuarial valuation of the Unemployment Insurance Fund in 2022. The Actuarial valuation results provided important insights for reforming the unemployment insurance fund.
